titre: Croissance de la population par région américaine
sous_titre: Variation en pourcentage entre avril 2020 et juillet 2025, par tranche d'âge

Sud.texte: the South was the only region whose population under 18 grew from 2020 to 2025; its growth of 1.1%

Nord-Est.texte: its growth of 0.1% (about 19,000) stood apart from the modest declines of the Northeast (-7.1%), Midwest (-6.2%), and West (-2.7%)

Midwest.texte: its growth of 1.1% contrasted with declines for the Northeast (-4.1%), Midwest (-3.9%), and West (-5.7%)

Ouest.texte: the West had the largest percentage decrease in the population under 18 (-5.7%)
